title: Encrypted DNS Discovery RFC 9463 Generic DNR Information Verification
verification_method: Focused unit tests, SpecTrace JSON validation, generated coverage triage, DNS package build, full solution test, and diff hygiene for the RFC 9463 generic DNR information surface.
scope: This verification covers ADN presence and validation, resolver IP address-list preservation, loopback and multicast filtering without reordering, service-priority exposure, RFC 9460 SvcParam wire encoding and rejection of invalid parameter sets, ADN-only mode across all DNR option families, DHCPv6 ORO request data, OPTION_V6_DNR non-singleton metadata, and DHCPv4 OPTION_V4_DNR option-data length handling.
preconditions: The RFC 9463 specification exists as canonical JSON at `specs/requirements/quic/SPEC-QUIC-RFC9463.json`.
The scalar and wire helpers are available in `Incursa.Quic.Dns`.
expected_result: The focused generic-information tests pass, the DNS package builds, core SpecTrace validation accepts the RFC 9463 artifacts, generated triage reflects the generic-information slice, diff hygiene passes, and the full solution test suite remains green.
status_summary: The RFC 9463 generic DNR information requirements are trace-owned and verified. Platform adapter and host resolver installation work remains outside this slice.
